sentences.sentence: Could you imagine what it would be like to be a king or queen?
I would enjoy having my own castle.
My castle would have an indoor swimming pool.
I could go swimming anytime I want.
I think I would enjoy traveling all over the world.
I love skiing, so I might go skiing in Switzerland.
I could use my money to help endangered animals.
Don't you think it would be awesome to be a king or queen?
